title: Contact Hub plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description: See docs/plugin-api.md section 3.2. Unknown fields are ignored.

id.description: The platform id. Lowercase, starts with a letter, 2-32 chars. Immutable once published.

entry.description: argv to spawn. entry[0] starting with ./ is resolved against the plugin directory.

auth_methods.description: Known values: phone_code, password_2fa, qr, email_code, token, oauth, username_password, none. Others are shown verbatim.

settings_schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the per-account settings form. String properties may carry x-secret: true.

AuthMethod.description: Registry of well-known auth method names.
